result:
Never-Sold looks at you and waits.
Topics:
  1. What do the Chainbreakers need done?

Never-Sold: "There is a woman north of Blackrose called Rows-For-Another. Eleven years ago she damaged one of an estate's boats. The estate's steward assessed her an Owing of four months' work. She works it still. I have put by what that Owing was at first: one hundred gold. By custom an Owing paid at its first price is closed. It is never mentioned again. Take the coin. If you can talk the steward round without it, keep it. From here take the swamp road north out of Blackrose. The channel bank is a short walk on. The steward Hulm-Tei stands there with his book. Hear what Rows-For-Another wants before you do anything."
Quest started: Four Months for a Boat

I'm to speak to Rows-For-Another on the channel bank, a short walk north of Blackrose along the swamp road, where Hulm-Tei, the estate's steward, stands with his book.

Rows-For-Another: "Never-Sold would do that for me? Then I will take it. Look at my skin. Eleven years away from my tree has turned it grey. I want to go home before it greys further. It is slow, and I will not pretend otherwise. Hulm-Tei keeps the book with my page in it. He must be paid the first price or talked round before he will strike it. I will say no more of him, because he is standing there and he can hear us. When the page is struck, the old custom closes the Owing for good. It is never spoken of again. It frees me. It does not change how the estate treats the next one held. Hulm-Tei will give you the page. Take it down the swamp road to Never-Sold in Blackrose."
Objective completed: Speak to Rows-For-Another on the channel bank north of Blackrose.
Journal entry (Four Months for a Boat): Rows-For-Another told me she will take the buy-out. By custom an Owing paid at its first price is closed, but Hulm-Tei, the estate's steward, holds her page in his book, and the sum on it has grown every season. I'm to pay him the first price from Never-Sold's coin, or talk him into striking the page; he stands just along the channel bank from her.
New objective: Pay Hulm-Tei the Owing's first price (100 gold), or persuade him to strike Rows-For-Another's page (Speechcraft 25).
